doctors.name: Dr. Julie Namm, MD
bio: Dr. Julie Namm specializes in comprehensive family care, preventive medicine, and managing chronic health conditions for patients of all ages.
She is deeply committed to holistic wellness, long-term patient education, and providing personalized healthcare tailored to every stage of life.

doctors.name: Bannuar Quiaoit, FNP
preview: Committed to providing compassionate primary healthcare services.
Focuses on patient-centered health education and disease prevention.
bio: Bannuar Quiaoit is a dedicated Family Nurse Practitioner committed to providing compassionate primary care and patient-centered health education.
He focuses heavily on early disease prevention, routine wellness exams, and helping patients navigate chronic condition management.

doctors.name: Elena Taneva-Cholakova, FNP
preview: Brings dedicated family nursing expertise and personalized patient attention.
Focuses on holistic wellness, lifestyle medicine, and routine screenings.
bio: Elena Taneva-Cholakova brings dedicated family nursing expertise with a core focus on holistic wellness, preventative health screenings, and community care.
She works closely with patients to emphasize lifestyle medicine, empowering them to take charge of their everyday physical and mental health.

doctors.name: Dr. Edwin Supit, MD
preview: Focuses on comprehensive internal medicine for adult patients.
Prioritizes advanced disease prevention, accurate diagnosis, and chronic care.
bio: Dr. Edwin Supit focuses on comprehensive internal medicine, prioritizing adult disease prevention, precise diagnosis, and long-term care management.
He has extensive experience helping adult patients navigate complex medical histories and multi-system chronic health conditions.

doctors.name: Dr. Sam Song, MD, FACOG
certifications: Certified Practitioner by the Menopause Society
Fellow of the American Congress of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (FACOG)
preview: 28 years of clinical experience in OB/GYN care.
Well Woman Health Exams & Cervical Cancer Screening.
High-Risk Obstetric Care & Minimally Invasive Surgery.
bio: Dr. Sam Song brings 28 years of extensive experience in obstetrics and gynecology, providing specialized women's health and reproductive care services.
He is dedicated to maintaining a safe, welcoming environment, emphasizing preventative screenings, and delivering exceptional general OB/GYN care across all stages of a patient's life.

doctors.name: Dr. William Vercio, MD
preview: Has extensive clinical experience in comprehensive women's health services.
Specializes in advanced maternal-fetal care and specialized treatments.
bio: Dr. William Vercio has extensive experience in women's health services, maternal-fetal care, and comprehensive gynecological treatments.
He is committed to delivering attentive, high-standard medical care tailored to the unique clinical needs of every patient.

bio: Serving as Medical Director, Dr. Danny McClure delivers specialized psychiatric evaluations and integrated mental health treatment plans.
He takes a whole-person approach to behavioral medicine, blending clinical psychiatry with supportive therapeutic strategies.

bio: Dr. Alan Butler specializes in comprehensive psychological assessments, therapeutic support, and evidence-based cognitive behavioral treatments.
He provides a safe, empathetic space for patients seeking help with emotional well-being, life transitions, and mental health challenges.
